observed_function.name: _predict_model_random_batches
behavior: permutes all input indices with a seeded NumPy generator
uses deterministic irregular batch sizes drawn with rng.integers(113, 389)
calls the submitted model separately on each permuted batch
restores predictions to their original index order

claim_scope: This establishes the evaluator batching behavior used in the Task 6 audit. It does not by itself establish that every batch-dependent model violates a written rule or record a Jury ruling.
